readerCopy.body: A story becomes much harder to question when belief and power start reinforcing each other. When Neptune conjoins Pluto, ideals, fears, imagination, and collective longing fuse with control, secrecy, and influence, giving movements, institutions, and narratives unusual emotional force. Something can feel sacred or inevitable and still deserve scrutiny. The strongest warning sign is what becomes easier to justify once enough power depends on everyone believing the same account.
